766751101.text: One more plate... Okay, this is the last one! Paimon swears!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Varka at the Favonius Keep

766750101.text: ...Nannina's covering the north, so we'll have Laurent take the east... Right, that's all for now.

766750103.text: Huh? Honorary Knight? Paimon? What brings you to my camp?

766750106.text: Not at all! Any camp of the Knights of Favonius is your camp too, so make yourself at home.

766750107.text: Though you should give me a heads up next time so I can have the quartermaster break out the good stuff for you.

766750108.text: Is this really the expeditionary force's camp? Paimon was expecting it to be a bit more... crowded?

766750109.text: Not many from the force are still stationed here, and of those who are, most are out patrolling. Truth be told... Hahaha, it is a bit of a ghost town.

766750110.text: What are the people left here doing?

766750111.text: Gathering all the Abyss-related intel we can. Naturally, we're focusing on dealing with the Wild Hunt right now.

766750112.text: To that end, we're collecting intel from across Nod-Krai. Even with Rerir sealed, things haven't completely quieted down yet.

766750113.text: We're also gathering all the Abyss-related intel we can. Situation in Nod-Krai's stable for now, but we must remain vigilant. You never know when the Abyss'll come roaring back.

766750114.text: Intelligence is the foundation of any campaign. It's not just enemy movements — terrain or shifts in the weather can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

766750115.text: Moving forward, we plan to form a long-term partnership with the Northern Intelligence Network, turn this temporary camp into an intelligence station.

766750116.text: A—An intelligence station? Whoa, like the kind in Fontainian spy thrillers!?

766750117.text: Haha, as if! Name one book with a camp this lightly defended in it!

766750118.text: During these years out on campaign, we've found that different Abyssal disasters are occurring all over Teyvat. They're unnaturally cunning, always shifting, with no two attacks quite going off the same.

766750119.text: I hope to use the Northern Intelligence Network to share our findings, and use that collaboration to keep gathering information on the Abyss.

766750120.text: This isn't any one nation's burden. Every day, countless winds blow through Nod-Krai... I'd say that makes it the perfect place to set up an outpost.

766750121.text: Ohhh, so that's why... So this is "chivalry" in action!

766750122.text: Haha! Well, "chivalry"'s good and all, but in reality... We've only just established this station, and don't even have a good map of the nearby terrain.

766750123.text: If you stumble across any building materials or intel nearby, don't forget to bring them back with you.

766750124.text: Rest assured, you're our Honorary Knight. We'll look after you.

766750126.text: Ha, one expedition wraps up, another begins.

766750127.text: G—Grand Master! We've got big trouble, Sir!

766750129.text: That important guest we were expecting today... He's trapped at the foot of the mountain!

766750130.text: WHAT!? Is it... who I think it is!?

766750131.text: Yes, Sir! It's him! Most of our available manpower is tied up in patrols. Who do we reassign...

766750132.text: —No need! Just point me in the right direction, I'll handle it myself! Honorary Knight, Paimon, 'til next time!

766750133.text: Varka storms out like the very wind...

766750134.text: ...Whoa, Paimon's never seen Varka so nervous! Now she's curious who that guest is...

766750135.text: Could it be... a critical informant?

766750136.text: Yeah, that's probably it! Let's follow him and see if he needs help!

766750402.text: I—I'm fine... Phew, good thing you guys showed up so fast, or I might not have made it by sundown.

766750403.text: ...Praise be! Our "essential supplies" made it through, safe and sound.

766750404.text: Uh, what kind of supplies are that important...?

766750407.text: Good eye! This here is the Dandelion Wine we specially ordered from Dawn Winery! Pure Mondstadt in a bottle!

766750408.text: You have no idea what it took us to get it here all the way from there.

766750409.text: Hah, and a fine job you did! You're drinking with us at the feast tonight. Whole camp's been looking forward to toasting you!

766750410.text: ...So the only reason you were in a hurry was to make sure the drinks got there in time? And here Paimon thought you were finally being serious about something serious...

766750411.text: What's that? Are you saying drinking isn't the most serious of serious business? Because I'd love to have a drink right about... now.

766750412.text: W—Wait! Please, wait a second! Now's not a good time!

766750413.text: Yeah, listen to him! First, you gotta take care of the serious...

766750414.text: This is a custom brew, it needs to be kept constantly rolling to prevent settling and keep its flavor! Having sat for so long, I'd say the taste has degraded... by at least ten percent!

766750415.text: Ten percent!? Unacceptable! Nobody touches a drop 'til it's ready!

766750417.text: So, how can we bring it back up to scratch?

766750418.text: We specially commissioned someone to build a mechanism that keeps the barrels rolling... Looks like it broke in the fall, though. So now, I guess we'll have to rely on old-fashioned muscle power.

766750419.text: Hmm, so we just <color=#00E1FFFF>keep whacking the wooden barrels and roll 'em to their destination</color>...? Sounds like some good old Knights of Favonius strength training.

766750420.text: Wait, the Knights train that way?

766750421.text: Aye, teaches force control and precision. Need both, or the barrel won't stay true to the path. It's basic training for many knights.

766750501.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

766750503.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

766750505.text: Back when I was training Noelle, she'd blast the barrels to splinters the second she got nervous. Couldn't stop her from cleaning up the whole mess herself afterward.

766750506.text: Over time... She became the finest cleaner in the Knights, bar none. Ha, she might not have realized it, but that's progress too.

766750601.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

766750603.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

766750605.text: First time I did this training with Razor, it took us an entire day to finish. Know why?

766750606.text: —He spent a quarter of the day rolling the barrels, and the other three quarters trying to figure out what the heck I was talking about.

766750701.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

766750703.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

766750705.text: Jean and Albedo once sat me down to have a serious discussion about whether or not the Spark Knight needed to take part in basic training like this.

766750706.text: A knight's basic training helps build character, but since the Spark Knight's still so young... I decided to get her opinion.

766750707.text: ...She happily brought her bombs to the training grounds. And so, we reached a consensus: We won't discuss the matter again until she's a bit older.

766750801.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

766750803.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

766750805.text: Come to think of it, you haven't met Lohen yet, have you? Kid's so used to doing things his way, he didn't even show up when it was time for the training.

766750806.text: Asked him about it later, he said he went to poke a hornet's nest full of monsters, and as for barrel drills... He didn't think targets that wouldn't hit back were worth his time.

766750901.text: Ah! Grand Master! Honorary Knight! They're back!

766750902.text: They're back! They're back! Everyone, fall in and give 'em a proper welcome!

766750903.text: Wow, we're this popular? Paimon feels like blushing...

766750904.text: —How the wind carries that scent from afar! Sweet Barbatos, it's true! Dandelion Wine!

766750905.text: A special brew from Dawn Winery, to boot! They're back... all my precious memories... they're all flooding back!

766750906.text: Uh... So, the welcome isn't for us, is it...

766750907.text: Yes, this is it, this is the taste... It's just how I remembered it!

766750909.text: Ah, I was starting to think I'd already forgotten the taste of a good Dawn Winery vintage...

766750910.text: If the taste hasn't changed... then my home back in Springvale probably hasn't changed either... right?

766750914.text: ...That's enough, put a cork in it, everyone. Barrels stay sealed until everyone's back. Let's finish the party prep in the meantime.

766750916.text: ...Like I said: Drinking is the most serious of serious business.

766750917.text: Ooooh... Sticky Honey Roast... Sweet Madames... Paimon never thought she'd get to eat such authentic Mondstadt dishes out here...

766750918.text: Uh, wait, where's Varka? Anyone seen him? He's not passed out drunk in a ditch somewhere, is he?

766751001.text: So, what's the hero who saved our savior and brought it back to camp doing in a corner like this?

766751004.text: Heh... Truth is, what I've got in my cup is the most special of special brews. It can only be drunk alone...

766751005.text: ...But since you've caught me, nothing for it. Here, have a cup.

766759906.text: Jean and Albedo once sat me down to have a serious discussion about whether or not the Spark Knight needed to take part in basic training like this.

766759907.text: A knight's basic training helps build character, but since the Spark Knight's still so young... I decided to get her opinion.

766759908.text: ...She happily brought her bombs to the training grounds. And so, we reached a consensus: We won't discuss the matter again until she's a bit older.

766759909.text: Come to think of it, you haven't met Lohen yet, have you? Kid's so used to doing things his way, he didn't even show up when it was time for the training.

766759910.text: Asked him about it later, he said he went to poke a hornet's nest full of monsters, and as for barrel drills... He didn't think targets that wouldn't hit back were worth his time.
